original_requirement: S08: GC preserves selected revisions and ancestry for supported active and held source roots, including restart.
delivered: Exact installed MCP source recovery after real edit/deletion, explicit GC, process restart and a second GC, using independent source bytes and hashes.
verified: Initial three-file corpus is recovered through literal search_memory citations and complete get_chunk JSON, with exact UTF-8 content, byte counts and BLAKE3 hashes.
After real edit/deletion and update, only replacement and stable-sibling source documents are returned; the sibling keeps its document identity and hash; old edited/deleted identities are absent.
GC preserves the published head. Native vector_search returns exactly the current lexical source document IDs, before and after restart/GC.
Fresh process opens the same owned data after the first process and reader close. Source identities and exact bodies survive both cold recovery and a second public GC.

Native public maintenance reports real compaction (3 fragments to1) in the warm run. Cold history maintenance explicitly defers because a native epoch is held; retention remains correct. No requirement to force unsafe pruning was added.
limitations: These are two configurations of the installed native-feature executable; fts_only is not a no-vector executable. Prior native/no-vector held-reader evidence is retained separately, not rerun or relabeled.
Exact source/body/document recovery does not measure physical write volume, bytes reclaimed, semantic ranking quality or machine resource bounds.
No durable user rollback-pin API exists. This check does not introduce one, test arbitrary head rewinds or establish exhaustive crash/fault coverage.
Full original S08 remains partially verified; the finite installed GC/restart acceptance gap is now closed.

temporary_resources.retained: Wire responses, source oracles, stderr, verifier and receipts retained for review. No production project/configuration or preexisting-folder deletion.
